label: Antaira LMP-1204G-SFP-24
description: Antaira LMP-1204G-SFP-24 12-port industrial Gigabit PoE+ managed switch: 8x 10/100/1000BASE-T IEEE 802.3af/at PSE at up to 30 W a port, 4x 100/1000 dual-rate SFP cages, 24 Gbps backplane, 180 W PoE budget (90 W of it at 12 V DC, the full 180 W only from 48-55 V DC), 12-55 V DC input, -10 to 65 C model.

poe.note: Datasheet PoE power budget table: 180 W at 48-55 V DC for LMP-1204G-SFP and LMP-1204G-SFP-T; 90 W at 12 V DC and 180 W at 48-55 V DC for the -24 models, whose 12-55 V DC input is boosted for PoE. 180 W against 8 x 30 W means a full 30 W fill of all eight ports is not available: the budget covers 6 ports at 30 W, or 8 ports at 22.5 W.

fabric.note: Datasheet back-plane (switching fabric) 24 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of twelve 1G ports.

notes: Datasheet 'LMP-1204G-SFP(-T) / LMP-1204G-SFP-24(-T)' V1.0. Ports 1-8 are the PoE+ RJ45 ports, 9-12 the dual-rate 100/1000 SFP cages. System power 15.5 W with no PD. Serial console is 1x RS232 via RJ45 at 115.2 kbps 8-N-1; 54 x 142 x 99 mm, 0.99 kg (0.95 kg on the -24 models), metal IP30, DIN-rail and wall mount, relay contact 24 V DC 1 A. MAC table 8K, VLAN groups 4095, IGMP groups 1024, 4 Mbit packet buffer, 9.6K jumbo. Discrepancies against the older hardware manual (V1.2, February 2018): the manual's power table gives 200 W at 48 V DC and 240 W at 51-55 V DC and quotes -10 to 70 C for the standard-temperature model, while the current datasheet states a 180 W PoE budget and -10 to 65 C. The datasheet is the newer product document and is what is modelled here. The datasheet also calls the box Layer 2 while the product page says 'Light Layer 3'; no routing feature is listed, so it is catalogued as a switch.
